name: blue-pill
description: Blue Pill (STM32F103CBT6, 128KB flash / 20KB SRAM), HSE 8MHz -> PLL x9 = 72MHz. Active-low LED on PC13. Console USART1: TX PA9 / RX PA10 @115200 (same pins as the ROM serial bootloader). I2C1 SCL PB6 / SDA PB7, I2C2 SCL PB10 / SDA PB11. Pin numbers in this metadata use port*16+pin (PA0..15=0..15, PB=16..31, PC=32..47). Flash via SWD (st-flash) or the UART1 bootloader; the linked final.bin image goes to 0x08000000.
